phase3_findings.description: Recorded densities claimed false and ceiling too loose
Four doc statements assert the ceiling without the exemption channel
AC13 assertion derives its over-ceiling set from a wider population than the lint audits
create-issue-context.md still denies the gate over 15 of its own gated references
run.sh header comment universalizes fail-closed to every loading command
Nested skill root outside the root-anchored pattern; .md filter residual undisclosed
Expired-exemption message names the default record path, not the one read
A disagreeing marker pair drops out of the population with no breadcrumb
recorded_set/exemptions two-list schema; expires_when free text

fix_decisions.claim_text: the recorded densities are false against HEAD and the 61,750 ceiling admits files over the token cap
fix_decisions.evidence: the finding divided token counts observed from the PLUGIN-CACHE copies (68,901 / 73,799 / 81,869 bytes) by those files' current post-trim repo sizes; measured against the copies actually read the densities are 2.600 / 2.833 / 2.887, so the floor 2.60 and ceiling 61,750 are correct

parking_evidence.basis: the finding paired token counts and byte counts from two different artifacts at the same paths
parking_evidence.failing_input: skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md: 68,901 B in the plugin cache vs 61,731 B in the repo, both reported against 26,496 tokens

fix_decisions.claim_text: collapse recorded_set and exemptions into one list
fix_decisions.evidence: AC9 requires the check to refuse an exemption naming a file outside the recorded set, which a single-list schema cannot express

parking_evidence.basis: the proposed schema change would remove the construct an acceptance criterion names
parking_evidence.failing_input: an exemption row for a file never recorded

fix_decisions.claim_text: a disagreeing marker pair is excluded with no breadcrumb distinguishing it from an ungated file
fix_decisions.evidence: real but additive: the exclusion is now pinned by three new fixture arms, so the behaviour is asserted; emitting a near-miss breadcrumb is a new feature beyond this issue's scope
